notes: Zengwei CTC/AED Small. Standard CTC head on Zipformer-Small encoder, size-matched to CR-CTC-small (22.1M encoder). Encoder shaped jointly by AED loss (90%) + CTC loss (10%) during training; we use only the CTC head for inference (159 attention-decoder keys ignored on load). This is Option B from the experiment plan. An earlier attempt with desh2608's pure standard-CTC Zipformer (86M, zipformer_ctc recipe) was abandoned because that recipe uses a different CTCModel class incompatible with our forward_encoder/ctc_output API.
stale_info: Earlier checkpoint_info.json saved during the failed desh2608 attempt was overwritten on 2026-05-10 to reflect the actually-used model.
